cfa_fdr.note: CFA Total Fire Ban and Fire Danger Rating forecast for all of Victoria. DataVic dataset cfa-data-feeds-for-incidents-total-fire-bans-fire-danger-ratings-and-latest-news, Country Fire Authority, CC BY 4.0. Each item is kept on the calendar day named in its text. Each district page URL is the link published on that district's CFA page. Fetched when this state is built. If the live feed cannot be read, the last successful parse is reused when it was fetched under 24 hours ago and still covers today or tomorrow in Australia/Melbourne. Otherwise the line is omitted. status.json sources.cfa_fdr stays ok false when the live fetch failed, including when a cached forecast is shown.

cfa_tfb_districts.note: Vicmap Admin Country Fire Authority Total Fire Ban District polygon (cfa_tfb_district). DataVic dataset vicmap-admin-country-fire-authority-cfa-total-fire-ban-district-polygon, CC BY 4.0. GDA2020 geographic coordinates. tfb_district matches the CFA forecast district name. A camp is rated only when the point is inside a polygon. Fetched when this state is built.

safety_html: Not an official warning service. A camp page can show the CFA fire danger rating and Total Fire Ban status for that camp's Total Fire Ban district. It does not republish VicEmergency incident warnings. Always check CFA fire danger ratings, VicEmergency, the Bureau of Meteorology warnings for Victoria and Parks Victoria changes of conditions before you travel. In an emergency call 000. VicEmergency hotline 1800 226 226.

faq.q: How do I know if a free camp in Victoria is open?
faq.a: DEECA Recreation Sites pages show the closure status and nearby Parks Victoria road and seasonal closures. OpenStreetMap campgrounds are not in that closure feed: the page says to check with the operator, and showgrounds say to call first. CampConditions.au does not republish VicEmergency warnings. Check VicEmergency, Parks Victoria and the Bureau of Meteorology before you travel. In an emergency call 000. The VicEmergency hotline is 1800 226 226.

The site rebuilds from DEECA and Parks Victoria sources several times a day. OpenStreetMap campgrounds and towns are refreshed weekly. Each page shows when it was built. Warning information is not included.
